entities.summary: Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Yusuf ibn Hud, known by the regnal name al-Musta'in Billah, was the fourth member of the Banu Hud family to rule the Taifa of Zaragoza. He ruled from 1085 to 1110. He was the son of Yusuf al-Mu'taman ibn Hud.
